title: Glossy
summary: GLOSS'Y, adjective Smooth and shining; reflecting luster from a smooth surface; highly polished; as glossy silk; a glossy raven; a glossy plum.

inlines.v: GLOSS'Y, adjective Smooth and shining; reflecting luster from a smooth surface; highly polished; as glossy silk; a glossy raven; a glossy plum.
